quotes/articles-heavenly-spiritual-manne: The Body of Christ is given, taken, and eaten, in the Supper, only after an heavenly and spiritual manner. And the mean whereby the Body of Christ is received and eaten in the Supper is Faith.
quotes/palmer-promise-father-para/text: Palmer argued that the outpouring of the Spirit at Pentecost fulfilled Joel’s promise that "your sons and your daughters shall prophesy", so that silencing Spirit-filled women is to quench the Spirit and hinder the Church’s witness.
quotes/lumen-gentium-subsists/text: Vatican II taught that the one Church of Christ confessed in the Creed "subsists in" the Catholic Church governed by the successor of Peter and the bishops in communion with him, while many elements of sanctification and truth are found outside its visible structure, which as gifts belonging to Christ’s Church impel towards unity.
quotes/ordinatio-sacerdotalis-para/text: John Paul II declared that the Church has no authority whatsoever to confer priestly ordination on women, and that this judgement is to be definitively held by all the faithful, appealing to Christ’s choice of twelve men and the Church’s constant tradition.
quotes/ignatius-lords-day/text: If, therefore, those who were brought up in the ancient order of things have come to the possession of a new hope, no longer observing the Sabbath, but living in the observance of the Lord’s Day, on which also our life has sprung up again by Him and by His death ...
quotes/justin-true-israel/text: For the true spiritual Israel, and descendants of Judah, Jacob, Isaac, and Abraham ... are we who have been led to God through this crucified Christ.
quotes/irenaeus-one-householder/text: For there is one and the same householder, who produced both covenants, the Word of God, our Lord Jesus Christ, who spake with both Abraham and Moses ...
quotes/augustine-witness-jews/text: Augustine taught that the Jews, scattered among the nations yet keeping their Scriptures, are unwitting witnesses to the prophecies fulfilled in Christ; applying Psalm 59:11 ("Slay them not"), he argued that they must be preserved rather than destroyed.
quotes/luther-regard-moses-para/text: Luther argued that Moses was given to the Jews and does not bind Gentile Christians except where his commandments agree with the natural law written on every heart; Christians should read him for God’s promises of Christ and for examples of faith.
quotes/calvin-third-use/text: The third use of the Law (being also the principal use, and more closely connected with its proper end) has respect to believers in whose hearts the Spirit of God already flourishes and reigns.
quotes/formula-concord-law-gospel-para/t: The Formula of Concord holds that the distinction between law and gospel must be preserved in the church with great diligence as an especially bright light, so that the word of God is rightly divided; the law reproves sin, while the gospel proclaims the forgiveness won by Christ.
quotes/hutchinson-examination-para/text: At her examination before the Massachusetts General Court, Hutchinson maintained that she had learned by an immediate revelation of the Spirit which ministers preached a covenant of grace and which a covenant of works, and warned the court that God would judge it for proceeding against her.
quotes/boston-marrow-para/text: Boston defended the Marrow’s teaching that Christ is freely offered to all sinners as they are, so that sinners need not first prove their repentance before they may come to him; the law drives to Christ, and obedience springs from grace rather than earning it.
quotes/cocceius-covenants-para/text: Cocceius taught that the covenant of works made with Adam is abrogated in successive stages, through the fall, the promise, the giving of the new covenant, the death of the body and the resurrection, while the one covenant of grace unfolds through the history of Israel and the church.
quotes/rushdoony-biblical-law-para/text: Rushdoony argued that every law-order expresses a religion, so a society that rejects God’s revealed law will inevitably enthrone another; the commandments and the case laws of Moses therefore remain the standard for personal, family, church and civil life.
quotes/nostra-aetate-jews-para/text: Nostra Aetate states that what happened in Christ’s passion cannot be charged against all Jews then living or against Jews today; that the Jews remain most dear to God because of their fathers; and that the Church, mindful of its common patrimony with them, deplores hatred, persecutions and displays of antisemitism at any time and by anyone.
quotes/theophilus-out-of-nothing/text: Theophilus argues that if God, like Plato’s craftsman, had merely shaped uncreated matter, he would be no greater than a human artisan who receives material from someone else; God’s power is shown precisely in making whatever he pleases out of what does not exist.
quotes/irenaeus-humanity-infant/text: Irenaeus says God could have given humanity perfection from the beginning, but humanity, newly created, was like an infant unable to receive it; the creature had to be made, grow, be strengthened and so come gradually to see God.
quotes/basil-beginning-of-time/text: Basil teaches that “in the beginning” signals that the world had a beginning and is not co-eternal with God, as some philosophers held; the Creator brought the world into being together with time.
quotes/augustine-world-with-time/text: Then assuredly the world was made, not in time, but simultaneously with time.
quotes/augustine-genesis-unbelievers/tex: Augustine warns that non-Christians often know a good deal about the earth, the heavens and nature from reason and experience; it is shameful when a Christian, claiming to speak from Scripture, talks nonsense about such things, for unbelievers will then dismiss Scripture where it speaks of resurrection and eternal life.
quotes/augustine-good-from-evil/text: For the Almighty God, who, as even the heathen acknowledge, has supreme power over all things, being Himself supremely good, would never permit the existence of anything evil among His works, if He were not so omnipotent and good that He can bring good even out of evil.
quotes/aquinas-secondary-causes/text: Aquinas argues that God works in every agent — giving it being, power and motion — yet creatures are true causes of their own effects; it does not belittle God but shows his goodness that he communicates to creatures the dignity of causing.
quotes/calvin-providence-governs/text: Calvin teaches that God is not an idle spectator who set the world going and then withdrew, but governs heaven and earth so that nothing happens by chance: not only the general order of nature but each particular event is directed by his counsel.
quotes/galileo-heaven-goes/text: The intention of the Holy Spirit is to teach us how one goes to heaven, not how heaven goes.
quotes/leibniz-best-world/text: Leibniz reasons that since God is supremely wise and good, he must have chosen, among infinitely many possible worlds, the best; the evils it contains are permitted because a world without them would, on the whole, be less good.
quotes/darwin-grandeur/text: There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed by the Creator into a few forms or into one; and that, whilst this planet has gone cycling on according to the fixed law of gravity, from so simple a beginning endless forms most beautiful and most wonderful have been, and are being, evolved.
quotes/hodge-darwinism-atheism/text: What is Darwinism? It is Atheism.
quotes/whitehead-fellow-sufferer/text: God is the great companion — the fellow-sufferer who understands.
quotes/morris-genesis-flood-para/text: Whitcomb and Morris argue that the plain sense of Genesis requires six ordinary days a few thousand years ago and a global Flood, and that the geological column is better read as the record of that Flood than of long ages; death entered the animal world only after Adam’s sin.
quotes/kline-framework-para/text: Kline argues that Genesis 2:5 assumes God’s providence worked by ordinary means during creation, so the days are a literary framework — a sabbatical pattern of two parallel triads — teaching that God is the sovereign Creator and Lord of the Sabbath, not specifying duration or sequence.
quotes/collins-biologos-para/text: Collins argues that the evidence for common descent, especially from shared genetic “mistakes”, is overwhelming, and that evolution can be understood as the means by which a transcendent Creator brought about the diversity of life — a harmony he calls BioLogos.
quotes/behe-irreducible-para/text: Behe argues that some biochemical systems, such as the bacterial flagellum, are irreducibly complex — they need all their parts to function — so they are unlikely to have been built by gradual steps, and are best explained by intelligent design.
quotes/hick-soul-making-para/text: Hick argues that the world is not a hedonistic paradise but a “vale of soul-making”: God created humans at an epistemic distance, immature, so that through freely meeting real challenges and suffering they might grow into children of God, a process to be completed beyond this life.
quotes/roth-protest-para/text: Roth argues that after Auschwitz, attempts to justify God’s permission of so much waste become obscene; faithful people may rather protest to and against God, as Job and the psalmists did, while still hoping in him.
quotes/pius-xii-humani-para/text: Pius XII allows that the evolution of the human body from pre-existing living matter may be studied and debated, provided Catholics hold that souls are immediately created by God, and he rejects polygenism as hard to reconcile with original sin.
quotes/pinnock-open-para/text: Pinnock argues that God, as a loving and relational being, created a world with genuinely free creatures and an open future; God knows all that can be known, responds to what creatures do and takes risks, rather than determining every event.
quotes/irenaeus-ten-thousand-branches/te: The days will come, in which vines shall grow, each having ten thousand branches, and in each branch ten thousand twigs, and in each true twig ten thousand shoots, and in each one of the shoots ten thousand clusters, and on every one of the clusters ten thousand grapes.
quotes/justin-thousand-years-jerusalem/t: But I and others, who are right-minded Christians on all points, are assured that there will be a resurrection of the dead, and a thousand years in Jerusalem, which will then be built, adorned, and enlarged, as the prophets Ezekiel and Isaiah and others declare.
quotes/tertullian-kingdom-upon-earth/tex: We do confess that a kingdom is promised to us upon the earth ... inasmuch as it will be after the resurrection for a thousand years in the divinely-built city of Jerusalem.
quotes/origen-superficial-view-letter/te: Certain persons, then, refusing the labour of thinking, and adopting a superficial view of the letter of the law ... are of opinion that the fulfilment of the promises of the future are to be looked for in bodily pleasure and luxury.
quotes/eusebius-papias-material-kingdom/: To these belong his statement that there will be a period of some thousand years after the resurrection of the dead, and that the kingdom of Christ will be set up in material form on this very earth.
quotes/eusebius-papias-limited-understan: For he appears to have been of very limited understanding, as one can see from his discourses.
quotes/augustine-joys-spiritual/text: And this opinion would not be objectionable, if it were believed that the joys of the saints in that Sabbath shall be spiritual, and consequent on the presence of God; for I myself, too, once held this opinion.
